name: Box Selection with Deselection
summary: With one controller, pressing the trigger fixes a corner of a box and moving the hand stretches it; releasing selects everything inside, and a mode switch lets the same box, or a touch, remove objects from the selection.
howItWorks: In VSVD the box is used both to select and to deselect, with a button toggling the mode (green box to add, yellow to remove). In VSPD the box selects and touching an object with the controller deselects it. With 12 participants on a Quest 2, selecting objects within arm's reach one by one with a touch was faster and more robust in random layouts, while the box variants were faster in a structured bookshelf scene; deselection was used mostly to fix mistakes.

relationships.note: A one-handed version of the two-corner box.
Compared with touching objects one at a time (PSPD).
